;Business and economy
*Chinese telecommunications giant [[Huawei]] sues the U.S. [[Federal Communications Commission]] over the latter's ban on carriers from using money from the [[Universal Service Fund]] to buy equipment from Huawei and [[ZTE]]. [https://techcrunch.com/2019/12/04/huawei-sues-fcc-over-unconstitutional-ban-the-use-of-federal-subsidies-to-buy-its-equipment/ (Tech Crunch)]

;Disasters and accidents
*Three [[Minnesota National Guard]] members are killed when a [[Sikorsky UH-60 Black Hawk]] helicopter crashes near [[St. Cloud, Minnesota|St. Cloud]]. [https://www.aol.com/article/news/2019/12/05/3-national-guard-members-dead-in-black-hawk-helicopter-crash-in-minnesota/23875024/ (AOL News)]

;International relations
*[[Bosnia and Herzegovina]] takes full control of the country's [[airspace]] for the first time since the end of the [[Bosnian War]]. Bosnia's air space had been controlled by [[NATO]] between 1995 and 2003, following which it was controlled jointly by [[Serbia]] and [[Croatia]] until this announcement. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-bosnia-airspace-control/post-war-bosnia-to-take-full-control-of-air-space-for-first-time-idUSKBN1Y81SJ (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[Indonesian police]] arrest more than 34 people over "charges of [[treason]]" for attempting to raise the outlawed [[Morning Star flag]], which represents the independence movement of [[West Papua Province]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/404931/dozens-face-treason-charges-for-flag-activities-in-papua (RNZ)]
*[[Accounting fraud]]
**The [[U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission]] charges Neil Cole, former CEO of [[Iconix Brand Group]], with accounting fraud. [https://www.reuters.com/article/iconix-brand-grp-fraud/iconix-brand-former-ceo-charged-with-accounting-fraud-idUSL4N28F3RV (Reuters)] 
*In [[Miramar, Florida]], police pursuing jewel thieves through traffic engage in a [[2019 Miramar shootout|shootout]] leaving both perpetrators dead alongside two bystanders (one of whom was a [[United Parcel Service|UPS]] driver who had been taken hostage). [https://www.miaminewtimes.com/news/miramar-shooting-updates-everything-we-know-about-police-the-ups-driver-and-bystander-11325800 (''Miami New Times'')]
*[[Impeachment inquiry into Donald Trump]]
**[[Speaker of the United States House of Representatives|U.S. House Speaker]] [[Nancy Pelosi]] announces the [[United States House of Representatives|U.S. House of Representatives]] will begin to draft [[articles of impeachment]] against [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] before the [[Christmas]] recess. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/12/05/us/politics/pelosi-impeachment.html (''The New York Times'')]

*[[2019 French pension reform strike]]
**A national strike begins in [[France]] over [[President of France|President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]]'s pension reform plan. [https://www.npr.org/2019/12/05/785018695/national-strike-in-france-shuts-down-cities-over-macrons-pension-reform-plans (NPR)]
